user.title: Home Mind Bridge
user.description: Connect to the Home Mind app and make an address Claude can link to.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the Home Mind app. Is it running?

key.name: Key
key.description: subject|attribute, so a new value replaces the old one.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: note, fact, task, procedure or episode.

show_link.name: Show link
show_link.description: Show the address to link Claude to Home Mind again.

call.description: Use one of Home Mind's own features from a script (pantry, meals, ask).

person.name: Person
person.description: Their name as Home Mind knows them.

scope.name: Scope
scope.description: read, write (remember things) or admin (also control the house).
